title: My Brother Took My $85K Laundromat And Banned Me. So I Watched Him Mop In 'Trust Wash Out'
description: I used my entire $85,000 pension to buy a laundromat with my brother. He forged my signature, stole the business, and banned me, until I found the original partnership agreement in my safety deposit box. Now he works the night shift as my janitor, wearing a uniform that says 'Trust Wash Out' while the neon sign flashes 'Sudsy Justice.' #FamilyBetrayal #RevengeStory #SudsyJustice
thumb_text: HE STOLE MY PENSION, NOW HE MOPS MY FLOORS
pinned_comment: If you had poured your entire $85K pension into a business with a sibling, only to have them forge your signature and ban you from the property, what would you have done? Share your story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: I FOUND THE ORIGINAL AGREEMENT AND SUED FOR FRAUD
